candidate: Exposure-shrunk FPL expected goals and expected assists as per-stat fallback only when detailed linked-history exposure is absent; FPL rows must have been ingested by decision cutoff.
baseline: Existing detailed-history and position-prior fit; unchanged scoring and minutes behavior.
paired_unit: Same eligible player-game rows, targets, cutoff, exclusions, seed and simulation rules for baseline and candidate.
cohorts: rows where xG detailed history is unusable
rows where xA detailed history is unusable
unchanged rows with usable detailed history
primary_metrics: Poisson deviance for goals per player-game (lower is better)
Poisson deviance for assists per player-game (lower is better)
secondary_metrics: MAE of goals and assists per 90
promotion_rule: No promotion unless all sample minima pass and both primary metrics improve by at least 2%, calibration slope is within range, and no position cohort with >=50 events regresses by >1%. Otherwise label experimental or reject. Synthetic tests do not count as performance evidence.
known_data_gate: M00 preserved database reports zero eligible 2026 gameweeks; do not run or claim validated paired performance unless a later eligible evaluation dataset is identified.
